visual_identity.core_identity: Natural cave bats with unmistakable membrane wings supported by elongated finger bones, pointed ears, compact mammal bodies, and clawed roosting feet.
visual_identity.silhouette: Compact torso, broad membrane wings, large ears, clawed hind feet; swarm variants repeat the same anatomy at smaller scale.
visual_identity.head_features: Natural bat face with short muzzle and prominent ears, never humanoid or draconic.
visual_identity.body_shape: Light flying mammal body with wings formed by elongated fingers and thin membranes.
visual_identity.surface: Short restrained body fur and smooth wing membranes with minimal vein detail.
visual_identity.limb_structure: Forelimbs are true bat wings formed by elongated finger bones supporting a continuous membrane; hind limbs end in small clawed roosting feet. Never add separate humanoid arms.
visual_identity.shape_lock: Draw true bat anatomy with exactly four limbs total per bat: two forelimbs that ARE the membrane wings and two hind legs/feet; never add separate arms, hands, or an extra wing pair.

accuracy_checks: no dragon or bird anatomy appears
fur and membrane detail stay simple
forelimbs are the wings; no separate arms or hands exist

known_failure_modes.correction: restore natural bat ears, short muzzle, finger-boned membrane wings, and mammal torso
remove feathers and restore continuous skin membranes

scene_identity.size_impression: Light, compact flying mammal anatomy; exact scale follows the variant, but the body should never feel dragon-heavy or birdlike.
scene_identity.natural_posture: Hanging securely by clawed feet, clinging to stone or timber, or moving in controlled wing-powered flight with the compact body suspended between the wings.
behavior_style: roosting beneath ceilings, arches, or ledges
banking through clear cavern or chamber air
moving as a coordinated cluster when the variant is a swarm without giving individuals mascot poses
environment_fit: open cavern air with visible roosting or landing surfaces
